name: cx-goal-many-rules
task: Move the ball away from the door before you take the key. Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed. Whenever you are holding the key, try to have the door open at that moment or open it afterwards. Then open the door with the key and pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: the chain Existence(target_picked_up) with the hard Precedences (blocker_moved→has_door_key→door_open→target_picked_up) captures the stated order and forces every earlier step; the soft Absence(key_lost) and soft Response(has_door_key, door_open) match the 'try not to'/'try to' preference wording.

texts: Eventually pick up the mission's target box.
The key must not be taken before the ball has been moved away from the door.
The door must not be opened before the matching key has been acquired.
The target box must not be picked up before the door is open.
Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed (never lose the key before the door is open).
Whenever the agent holds the key, try to have the door open at that moment or open it afterwards.
